In the context of Jaquelyn, the name can be interpreted as 'little Jacques'. The name Jaquelyn carries the meaning “Jacques little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
